newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries buys rental car firm.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries buys rental car firm.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc. Wednesday said it agreed to buy Spirit Rent-A-Car Inc. for about $80 million in stock, its latest acquisition of a car rental company.
Republic said Spirit, based in Solon, Ohio, is the fourth largest provider of insurance-replacement rental cars in the United States, with 103 rental offices in 11 states.
Republic also said it has formed a Rental Car Division, which will consist of its National Car Rental, Alamo Rent-A-Car and Spirit Rent-A-Car units.
William Lobeck will become President of the division. Lobeck is president and chief executive of National Car Rental Systems Inc.
